$comment: Products, public evidence and implementation scope. A product listing does not imply that every proposed agent role or transaction flow is deployed.

products.name: Social Seeding
products.scope: Closed beta. The V2 walkthrough shows agent roles at different stages of implementation; people review outreach drafts before sending.

one.en: Creator campaign operations built around specialist agent roles, a shared brief and human decision points. The workflow covers sourcing, outreach, replies and verification.
one.ko: AI 담당자들이 같은 캠페인 정보를 보며 크리에이터 발굴, 제안 메일 작성, 답변 정리, 게시물 확인을 나눠 처리하도록 설계한 서비스입니다. 중요한 결정은 사람이 검토합니다.

products.name: kbeauty.market
products.scope: Storefront browsing preview. Own checkout is not yet enabled.

one.en: A video-first storefront that connects creator and brand clips, their original sources and product information.
one.ko: 크리에이터나 브랜드의 영상에서 제품을 발견하고, 제품 정보와 원본 영상을 함께 살펴볼 수 있는 쇼핑 서비스입니다.

products.name: Teslam
products.scope: Published concept and unit economics. The settlement pipeline remains a design.

one.en: Drive-to-earn for Tesla owners in Korea. The unit economics are public on the site; the settlement pipeline is a design, not a deployment. An independent project, not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.
one.ko: 한국 테슬라 오너를 위한 drive-to-earn. 단위 경제성 모델은 사이트에 공개돼 있고, 정산 파이프라인은 아직 설계입니다. Tesla, Inc.와 무관한 독립 프로젝트입니다.
